response.sql: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order"), 0) AS share FROM account_orders), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.order_count), 0) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share
